posts.title_en: Guild Conquest Season 6 final boards (top 100 players and guilds)
posts.summary_en: crumb.gg's live board, fetched 2026-10-07 19:45 KST, reads season 6, phase final, 10-01 16:00 to 10-05 12:00 KST, next season 10-08 16:00 KST (evidence/r2026-10-07/15-crumbgg/api/pub-live-guild_conquest_players.json). #1 Arsen (카페) 6T 276G, #2 바삭한반장 (바삭젤리단) 4T 910G, #3 날씨의아이 (카페) 4T 770G; #10 스타 4T 201G, #50 3T 341G, #100 2T 763G. The same players scored about 1.4–2.1× their Season 5 finals (by crumb.gg player id). Guilds: 카페 99T 957G, Carpediem 94T 287G, 방랑자 72T 092G. Arsen posted 5T 115G in 방랑자 on 10-02 (dc:79664) and is listed in 카페 at the end.

Top account power is 50.76G (newbiee, 카페), against 30.0G on 09-27; #50 is 36.05G and #500 21.83G (evidence/r2026-10-07/15-crumbgg/13-power-top500.tsv). Joined by name and guild, the Season 6 top 50 hold 23.6–50.8G account power (median 35.5G), and score ÷ account power runs 76–164× (median 110×). The highest-power account, newbiee, placed #19; Arsen (#1) holds 38.2G. Account power, not the forum's 12-cookie team power.

posts.title_en: crumb.gg Guild Conquest page: season dates, boss and phase table
posts.summary_en: Season 6 ended; Season 7 runs 10-08 to 10-12 (shown in the browser's CEST: Oct 8 09:00 – Oct 12 05:00). Boss: Extra-Stuffed Piñata, Dark, CC immune, HP ∞, ATK 5,000, DEF 2,000, 60 s. Its phase table, one row every 12 s: summon HP 6,668 → 1B, summon ATK 1,667 → 250M, boss ATK +10,000% → +31,250,000%, and damage reduction 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90%, 99% (evidence/r2026-10-07/15-crumbgg/40-guild-conquest-db.txt).
mechanics: Phase rows at 0/12/24/36/48/60 s cooldowns with DMG reduction 10/30/50/70/90/99% and summon ATK 1,667 / 168.3K / 8.34M / 41.67M / 83.33M / 250M.
Each phase: 2 s gift drop (0.125× ATK, radius 2), 4 s summons, 6.5 s wave hitting every enemy (1× ATK, knockback 5), 10.18 s slam (radius 10, knockback 10), 10.5 s the boss powers itself up.

posts.summary_en: Answers 200 with JSON on 2026-10-07 (evidence/r2026-10-07/15-crumbgg/api/data-patches.json). Newest entries: 1.5.002 on 10-08 (upcoming): Chardonnay Cookie (SSR Grass support; a line barrier giving CRIT% 50–100%, Push RES 40–60% and Volley 1–2 to herself and allies in the line, 5 s), max cookie level 100 → 120, EXP for Lv.79–100 cut, a 7-day check-in giving Milk; and an undated 1.4.002 hotfix (Rift boss HP, auto bake, Arena protection). No Guild Conquest change between 09-23 and 10-07.
mechanics: Chardonnay's kit grants 다발 (Volley) 1 at low grade and 2 at top grade, not 3 (data-patches.json, rich.cookies kit).
